across_options.issue: State hue and saturation vary as well as state shape. The Dot and Corner tag versions are especially fluorescent compared with the base. This changes the decided A1 palette during a D4 comparison.

The offer field changes independently of the named option: the base has clear crossing mesh lines, Hairline cards and Corner tag have weaker texture, and Dot reads smooth. The lime end also becomes brighter. These are D5 texture/palette differences.

The product images are not held fixed. The shoes change in their crop, proportions and visible arrangement; the lamp photo also changes its framing. These changes affect the item-led comparison independently of the new card outlines.

Content spacing changes within the lower items. The Nike image starts around y=665 rather than y=659, and the lamp around y=1019 rather than y=1006, while their action rows stay almost at the original heights. Card internal padding is also visibly inconsistent: the first card has much more space above its photo than the other two. This is more than adding outlines to otherwise fixed rows (brand/ledger.md D3 remains separate). Coordinates refer to the supplied 1024 x 1536 images.

The bottom navigation shifts upward: its top divider is around y=1378 in the base, y=1375 in Dot, and y=1371 in Corner tag. The icons, labels and home indicator move with it. State shape does not require this shell change.
